releases.displayName: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Free Update!

items.text: Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG series set in the world of Monster Hunter, where you become a Rider and form bonds with monsters, fighting alongside them as you embark on a journey with your friends. The third entry, Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, has a new free update, Ver. 1.1.0.0!
Battle Royal Monsters!
After applying the new update, load a file that was saved after completing the game for a more difficult version of the final battle.
Once you complete the hard version of the final battle, powerful Royal Monsters will begin to appear throughout the world, offering even more challenging battles.

Royal Monsters can be identified by a crown icon above their head. Try exploring the world to see what Royal Monsters you encounter! Monsters that may appear as Royal Monsters are also denoted by a crown icon in the Monsterpedia, so you can easily track whether you've defeated them yet.
Calamitous Elder Dragons and invasive monsters will also appear as Royal Monsters. Make sure you and your Monsties are well-prepared for these demanding battles!
Customize your character with new accessories, available as free DLC!
Check out the store page to download them!

releases.displayName: Update (March 16 2026) Trial Version - Save Data Transfer - Known Issue

items.text: Hey Riders,
Thank you all so much for your support for Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection since we launched earlier today, we really appreciate it!
Known Issue - Save Data Transfer

We're just dropping you a message to let you know that we're aware of an issue with the Steam version of the game where the button to transfer Trial Version save data is not displayed for some players, and that we're working on a hotfix to address this. Thank you for your patience and feedback whilst we work to fix this.

We'd also like to mention that the team are investigating reports of crashes that some players are experiencing. If you run into anything such as crashes etc, please contact our dedicated Customer Support team HERE so we can provide assistance whilst we look into this.
That wraps up our short post, but we just wanted to let you know of the above and that we're looking into what we're seeing and hearing from the community.

The Monster Hunter Community Team: Update (March 16 2026): *Important Note Regarding Save Data Transfer: Please note that attempting to transfer save data across to the full game by manually renaming the demo save file and copying it to the full version's save data will prevent the transfer from working correctly. This may cause unexpected behaviour, such as the game crashing.: Please use the dedicated in-game save data transfer method to avoid this issue. (To use this method, please ensure to save manually to Save Slot 1 in the demo if you have only been using auto-save.)

releases.displayName: UPDATE - Postponed: Monster Hunter Showcase coming Dec. 8 at 10 p.m. UTC!

items.text: In light of the recent tsunami warning issued due to an earthquake off the coast of Japan, we have decided to postpone the Monster Hunter Showcase broadcast which was scheduled for today. We'll share the new broadcast date with you all as soon as it's decided.
Monster Hunter Showcase | December 2025

The Monster Hunter Showcase is a digital event featuring news about Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, releasing March 13, 2026, and details on Monster Hunter Wilds Title Update 4, releasing December 16, 2025! The event will be available online starting December 8 from 2 p.m. Pacific Time or 10 p.m. UTC!
Stream Date and Time
Dec. 8 at 10 p.m. UTC (2 p.m. PT)
– Stream date and time are subject to change.
– The event is estimated at approximately 20 minutes.
– The Monster Hunter Wilds portion does not include news about anything other than Title Update 4.
